variants.name: rounded
variants.prompt: Create a single square PNG contact icon for Mixr. Use the reference only for the purple and gold palette; completely redesign the mascot as a minimal sculptural letter M. No face, eyes, chat tails, words, labels, decorative objects or mockup. One large centered recognizable M with generous safe margin for circular contact cropping. Premium translucent glass with controlled refraction, soft studio highlights, smooth bevels, minimal detail, strong small-size readability. Straight-on view, restrained depth. Entire square filled by a quiet background; no outer rounded app-icon frame. A single continuous rounded uppercase M made from thick clear lavender glass. Broad strokes, softly rounded corners, a clean central V notch. Tiny warm champagne-gold light reflection along one lower edge, predominantly lavender. Deep aubergine background, luminous edges but no neon glow. Simplest and most iconic of the set.
